notes: Rules are evaluated in 'order'; first match wins. One primary category per failed run. Severity: critical | high | medium | varies. retry_helps: yes | no | sometimes | unknown.

categories.definition: A safety filter, policy check or the model's own refusal stopped the run.
categories.example: Blocked by output policy: PII detected (credit card number)
categories.remediation: Review a sample for false positives; tune the policy; route to a human.

categories.definition: The prompt plus history exceeded the model's context window.
categories.example: 400 prompt is too long: 212,480 tokens > 200,000 maximum
categories.remediation: Summarize or trim history; retrieve less; split the task; larger-context model.

categories.definition: The agent repeated actions without progress until it hit the step limit.

signals.step_pattern: same tool_name with near-identical input >= 3 times in a row, or step_count at configured max

categories.example: AgentError: max_steps (25) reached without final answer
categories.remediation: Detect repeated calls early and stop; lower the step limit; improve tool descriptions and stop conditions.

categories.definition: A model or tool provider refused the call for too many requests or exhausted quota.
categories.example: 429 Too Many Requests: rate limit exceeded, retry after 20s
categories.remediation: Exponential backoff with jitter; honor Retry-After; cap concurrency; raise limits.

categories.definition: The model called a tool with malformed, wrong-type or made-up arguments, or an unknown tool.
categories.remediation: Return clear validation errors to the model; tighten tool schemas; look up IDs instead of letting the model guess.

categories.definition: A tool or external API failed for a reason other than rate limits, timeouts or bad arguments.
categories.remediation: Retry 5xx only, with a cap; circuit breaker per tool; alert the tool owner.

categories.definition: A step or the whole run exceeded its time limit.
categories.remediation: Per-tool timeouts; retry once; break long work into steps; investigate p95 latency.

categories.definition: The final output could not be parsed or did not match the required schema.
categories.remediation: Structured output or JSON mode; repair prompt with the parse error; more lenient parser.

categories.definition: The run finished cleanly but its output failed verification.
categories.remediation: Add or tighten output checks; feed check result into retry; human review sample; track by deploy_version.

categories.definition: A failed run that no rule above matched.
categories.remediation: Review weekly; add a rule or category when a pattern repeats in >= 3 runs. Keep share < 10% of failures.
